title: planning-banking-tests input
description: ENFORCED — the engine validates this ASSEMBLED stage input against this schema BEFORE the stage runs (engine/validation.py validate_stage_input; fail-closed, engine/config/runtime-binding.yaml input_validation: enforce). Shape below is the POST-adapter payload delivered at stage qa-plan.

epics.description: engine-hydrated: the ba-brief manifest's epic refs dereferenced into inline epic sidecar objects (see eliciting-banking-brief schemas/epic-sidecar.json).

story_files.description: The manifest's original story file refs, retained alongside the hydrated stories.

stories.description: engine-hydrated: mapping.py _hydrate_ba_research adds this key by dereferencing story_files into inline story sidecar objects (see eliciting-banking-brief schemas/story-sidecar.json).

idempotency_key.description: engine-injected: the workflow's single idempotency key, injected into every stage payload.

upstream_artifacts.description: engine-injected: map of producer stage id to its artifact path relative to this stage's dir.

loop_back_feedback.description: engine-injected (conditional): reviewer findings threaded into a re-run after a loop_back.

backend_review.description: engine-nested (NESTED_HANDOFF): the backend-review picks under their own key — flat merge would silently keep only the last review verdict.

frontend_review.description: engine-nested (NESTED_HANDOFF): the frontend-review picks under their own key — flat merge would silently keep only the last review verdict.
